title: Which clients cover which parts of the ZIdentity API: Python, Go and the MCP server

prose.text: ZIdentity is automated through the Python SDK's `zid` package, the Go SDK's `ziam` services and, for reads, the MCP server. Each SDK's modules and functions are generated (`node scripts/kb.mjs surface zid`); this subject records the coverage differences an agent needs when choosing between them.

prose.label: User actions.
prose.text: {{go-user-actions}} {{python-no-user-actions}} The Go paths for these actions differ from the contract's: [[zidentity.sdk-go:user-action-paths]].

prose.label: Python SDK line.
prose.text: [[shared.sdk-python.client-configuration:legacy-clients]] The Python v2 beta covers ZIdentity together with ZIA and ZDX: [[cloud-connector.api.client-coverage:python-v2-excludes-ztw]].

prose.label: MCP server.
prose.text: {{mcp-toolsets}} {{mcp-read-only}} {{mcp-lean-summaries}} {{mcp-no-admin-objects}} The MCP server keeps ZIdentity tools only when the token's service list maps `ZIAM` to them: [[shared.mcp-server.tool-inventory:entitlement-aliases]].

go-user-actions.statement: The Go users package wraps three user actions: `SetSkipMFA`, `ResetPassword` and `UpdatePassword`.

quotes: func SetSkipMFA(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, userID string, timestamp int64) (*http.Response, error) {
func ResetPassword(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, userID string) (*http.Response, error) {
func UpdatePassword(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, userID string, payload *UpdatePasswordRequest) (*http.Response, error) {
Note this is a PUT while the other two actions are POSTs.
executeUserAction issues one of the action requests above.

go-user-actions.conditions: Absence claim (no other action): `grep -c 'executeUserAction(' zscaler/ziam/services/users/users.go` in vendor/zscaler-sdk-go at v3.8.58 returns 4, the calls in `SetSkipMFA`, `ResetPassword` and `UpdatePassword` plus the helper's definition; users.go is the package's only file.

python-no-user-actions.statement: Besides `__init__`, the Python users module (`UsersAPI`) defines only `list_users`, `get_user`, `add_user`, `update_user`, `delete_user` and `list_user_group_details`; none of them sets skip MFA, resets a password or updates one.

def list_user_group_details(self, user_id: str, query_params: Optional[dict] = None) -> APIResult[List[UserRecord]]:

python-no-user-actions.conditions: Absence search: `grep -n -E '^\s*(async )?def ' zscaler/zid/users.py` at v1.11.3-1-g4f8f54df returns exactly those seven def lines (`__init__`, `list_users`, `get_user`, `add_user`, `update_user`, `delete_user`, `list_user_group_details`), and `git grep -i -E 'reset|skip_?mfa|password' -- zscaler/zid` at the same release returns nothing.

mcp-toolsets.statement: The MCP server's ZIdentity toolsets are `zid_groups` and `zid_users`, five tools each: get, list and search for groups and users, plus a group's members and a user's groups, which each have one tool by ID and one by name.

quotes: Inputs for listing the users that belong to a ZIdentity group by ID.
Inputs for listing the users in a ZIdentity group resolved by group name.
Inputs for listing the groups a ZIdentity user belongs to, by user ID.
Inputs for listing a ZIdentity user's groups, resolving the user by name.

mcp-read-only.statement: The MCP tool catalog marks all ten ZIdentity tools Read-only.

mcp-lean-summaries.statement: The MCP list tools `zid_list_users` and `zid_list_groups` return lean summaries rather than the full SDK record: users as id, login name, display name and primary email, groups as id, name, description, dynamic flag and source IdP.

quotes: | `zid_list_users` | `zid_users` | Read-only | List ZIdentity users. Read-only.  Returns lean user summaries (id, login name, display name, primary email) rather than the full SDK user record.

| `zid_list_groups` | `zid_groups` | Read-only | List ZIdentity groups.  Read-only. Returns lean group summaries (id, name, description, dynamic flag, source IdP) rather than the full SDK group record.

mcp-no-admin-objects.statement: No MCP tool reads or writes ZIdentity API clients, resource servers or user entitlements, and none writes users or groups.
mcp-no-admin-objects.conditions: The toolsets guide lists only these two ZIdentity toolsets, and the server's ZIdentity tool directory holds only groups.py and users.py at the pin.
